notes:
### Updater
- Updates are now staged in-process and applied by a tiny fixed `SDX.Loader.dll` on the next Revit start: no helper process and no new Revit security prompt per update; a version that fails to start is rolled back automatically. `SDX-Updater.ps1` remains an optional fallback (`UpdateMethod=Script`)
- New install layout: `SDX.addin` loads `SDX\SDX.Loader.dll`, which runs `SDX\versions\<version>\SDX.dll`. Revit shows its security prompt once after the `.addin` changes
- Staged download progress, an update-available toast and a single-prompt flow
- `SDX-Updater.exe` is removed; `SDX-Updater.ps1` is the only updater

### Template Sync
- New tool that keeps view templates in sync across sets, with baseline diffing, merge, exclusion rules, change coalescing and a set editor window
- Per-tab exclusion counts named explicitly (Filter, Imported Category, Model Category, Annotation Category); counts update live as you edit
- Per-tab syncing checkboxes with an On/Off status, and draggable pane widths
- Conflicting filters are shown and explained when applying
- Stored sets and baselines are protected, and staged sets are validated, with clearer messages

### Filter By Parameter
- Naming rules, saved preferences and a new settings dialog
- Auto names capitalise Multi; cleanup button text no longer clips

### Free Dims
- Manage command renamed to Edit, with a new edit mode, helper tagging, a mode window and updated toasts

### Reference Sections
- New tool for near-perpendicular sections; replaces the Perp Sections ribbon button. Section ends are ordered so the look direction matches the candidate

### Parameter Calc
- New tool; its report is written to `%APPDATA%\SDX\Reports` with 14-day cleanup

### Align Viewports
- Match Viewports Vertically renamed to Align Viewports, with an orientation choice

### View Template Snapshot
- Selecting or deselecting a parent category in the import preview selects or deselects all of its layers and settings; Select All and Deselect All do the same

### Other tools
- Move to Geo-Reference, Batch Link Files and Level Extents updated
- Breakline result toast simplified
- Tools that are still in development are only available on the Preview channel

### General
- User preferences migrated from XML to JSON, with one-time import of existing XML settings
- Daily shared log files with a size cap and process ID tagging
- Refreshed shared checkbox style, slider style and dialog buttons across all tools

### Removed
- Usage Counter tool (anonymous telemetry unaffected)
